detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Two days left before the NGINX ingress controller on NKE gets shut down.

The open alternative is here: HAProxy, orderable via Cockpit. We don't want you locked into a proprietary tool, and HAProxy is an open, community-driven standard.

Loki and Prometheus already work behind it. Rate limiting, IP allowlisting and redirects run through HAProxy annotations.

Migration guide: https://docs.nine.ch/docs/managed-kubernetes/nke/ingress

#kubernetes #devops #nke #haproxy #nine
